in_hindi.name: शिवकान्त
in_hindi.meaning: शिव (Shiva) + कान्त (के साथ विजय पाने वाला, able to conquer)

in_marathi.name: Shivakant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivakant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivakant is derived from the Hindu deity Lord Shiva, who is the god of destruction and regeneration. The name Shivakant is believed to bring power, strength, and protection.
